text_block_list.text:
One evening. After finishing my errands,
I was walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Look, Trainer. There's a crowd up ahead.
What's going on over there?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, stylish Uma Musume!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A lottery... you say!?
Crap, this is seriously bad...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing Pops got hooked on, and Mom got
totally furious with him. She went, 'Don't you go
wasting your life on gambles like this!'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just sit this one out!
My blood is boiling!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, just this once is fine, right?
Huh? Pleeease?

I happen to have a raffle ticket I got from shopping.
When I give a slight nod—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thank you! This is getting me hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Keep it a secret from my mom, though, okay?
Don't go snitching on me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! We only get one shot!
Trainer, might as well spin it together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Grip the lever. Shift into gear, and crank it with
everything you've got. Full throttle for the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaah!

Turning the lottery wheel with all my might,
to spit out a ball with everything I've got.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat?!
The grand prize?! HELL YEAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?! Nailed it!
How's that, huh?! Yeah! Hell yeah!

"Vodka rejoiced as if she had just won a race.
She seemed exceptionally thrilled."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn, my heart's still pounding like crazy...
This rush...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A raffle really is the culmination of romance.
This thrill... this excitement... I won't ever forget it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So... what do you get for the grand prize again?
choice_data_list: Apparently they're tickets for a hot spring trip

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip?!
You mean you and I can go together?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, that sounds swell!
Speakin' of hot spring inns..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's midway up a mountain pass or something.
Stopping by in the middle of a touring ride...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sweating it out in a hot spring, picking at delicious food...
Aahh, it really warms the soul.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's just one problem, though.
choice_data_list: What kind of problem is there?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have a motorcycle yet. Rattling
along on a train just to soak in a hot spring
would be nothing more than a company retreat, man."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is there some way to enjoy this coolly...?
After much thought—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
How about we hold onto this ticket for a while?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: By the time the Twinkle Series winds down, maybe I'll have a motorcycle of my own, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe you want to head out right away, Trainer,
but..."
choice_data_list: You can do whatever you like, Vodka.
You can do whatever you like, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Thanks!
Guess I'll save this coupon for the future, then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely going on a touring trip to the hot springs!
And then we'll passionately talk about conquering those mountain passes!"

And so, using the grand prize ticket was postponed.
One more exciting promise to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, first prize?!
Isn't this crazy good?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak."
Looks like they didn't hold back on the crazy-good ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now then, how should I cook this up...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Simmering it in red wine European-style might be nice, too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe finish it with a Japanese mustard sauce
for a sharp, refreshing touch. No, or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! No, no, no!
It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's only one way to eat a hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hang it from the tip of a branch! Roast it over the bonfire,
and dig in like a savage! That's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it later in the academy's courtyard.
This'll definitely get our energy pumping. Wahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Controlling the heat looks a bit tricky, though.

She was quite concerned about the grilling method.
In any case, it was great that we managed to get
such a nice prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, 2nd prize!
Not bad at all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A massive pile of carrots, huh? Great to eat at mealtime, or good to crunch on between training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, how do I put it…… it just doesn't look the part.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I mean how it looks carrying them home. Walking around with a giant paper bag stuffed full of carrots...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ain't this just a housewife on her way back from grocery shopping?
Kinda kills my whole image, y'know?
choice_data_list: Why not try holding it with a little swagger?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Acting cool... I see, that's one way to put it.
Then—how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, even with two full hands, you can't grasp it all.
This... "carrot" of mine, that is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! In the end, a carrot is still just a carrot! There's nothing cool about it~!

"I pushed a bit too hard after all.
In the end, we decided to split the carrots in half
and gratefully take them home."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, a carrot! And just one at that...
Talk about stingy...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Since they were so ridiculously hyped up,
they've crashed just as hard.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, want a carrot?
choice_data_list: No, why don't you eat it, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I could eat it myself,
but I'm not really feeling it, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Since we managed to win it,
why don't the two of us share it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even if it's just one carrot, if we share a bite, that's enough to share a friendship.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer.

The two of us leave the area.
With a flick of her wrist, Vodka casually caught
the carrot she'd tossed up behind her back.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, I whiffed it!
Totally and utterly whiffed itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I kind of figured... Pops never has
any luck at times like these either...
choice_data_list: Maybe it actually feels good instead?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Rather than barely missing, finishing
with a big fat zero is way more my style."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the tissues.
Might come in handy if I get a nosebleed or something.

Vodka rummages around and puts it in her pocket.
It looks like luck wasn't on her side in the lottery today.
